about: Aesthetic rubric scores (form/critique.py AESTHETIC, 0-5) for the game bench, refinement off: three new blind passes. The bench takes each item's median and caps it by the asset's game evidence. These are a model's judgement, not a measurement, and not a person's: a person should look and replace them.
scored_by: three blind passes by Claude subagents (an AI model), not a person
method: Three new blind passes by Claude subagents (an AI model), not a person, on 2026-11-25. Each pass saw only fourteen anonymous review sheets (LOD0 lit from four views and its 64 px outline): the seven assets of the refinement-on run and the seven of the refinement-off run, shuffled together with a fixed seed, the control among them, no names, briefs, numbers or key; each pass read them in its own order. The letters were mapped back to run and brief afterwards. One earlier third pass was discarded unused because it filed two sheets under each other's letters (its notes describe a wheel under a chest's letter and the reverse); a new third pass replaced it.

scifi_helmet: Stylized helmet with dark crest, visor and orange ear pods; the white shell reads lumpy and soft, and the rivets along the brow are sparse and uneven.
Stylized helmet with a dark fin, a visor recess and orange ear pods; the shell is lumpy and the rear bulges look unresolved, with a small strap clip at the back.
Stylized helmet with a crest fin, dark visor and orange ear pods; the shell is lumpy and soft, with mushy transitions and a thin wire trim.
wall_kit: Modular wall slab: brick face, a cinderblock back, and capstone and plinth tiers; the silhouette is a flat box, and small dark artifacts show at the bottom corners.
Brick wall slab with a coping cap, a plinth and a block-faced back; the outline is a flat slab and stray dark dots show at the brick-panel corners.
Flat wall slab with a coping cap and plinth; brick on one face and cinder block on the other, with small dark artifacts and bulges at the brick-panel corners.
fantasy_sword: Longsword with fuller, curved brass guard, wrapped grip and round pommel; clear silhouette, but the guard is simple and the edge bevels are thin.
Longsword with a fullered blade, a curved brass guard, a wrapped grip and a ball pommel; readable but simple, with a thin guard and few detail tiers.
Longsword with a fullered blade, curved brass guard, wrapped leather grip and round pommel; reads clearly, with a fairly simple guard.
tv_remote: Same remote as D: a rounded bar with a regular button grid and a two-tone body; competent but a plain slab outline.
Rounded-slab remote with a split-line shell, a button grid, a nav ring and a red key; clean but a generic bar silhouette.
Rounded-slab remote with an aligned button grid, ring D-pad, red accent and a body split line; tidy, but the silhouette is a plain bar.
treasure_chest: Same chest as C: wood planks with iron straps, a lock plate and a metal base band; tidy and stylized.
Domed wooden chest with plank grooves, riveted iron bands, a metal base trim and a brass lock plate; the outline reads well but is close to a box.
Domed wooden chest with plank grooves, riveted iron straps, a lock plate and a base band; good material pairing, standard form.
vehicle_wheel: Same wheel as H: even chevron tread, spoked alloy rim, and a good rubber/metal pairing.
Wheel with a chevron-tread tire, a five-spoke alloy rim and a hub cap; solid two-material read, but the tread looks shallow.
Tyre with a chevron tread and a five-spoke rim; decent rubber/alloy read, with a shallow tread and small holes in the outline.
control_blob: Same blob as K: a smooth untextured pebble with no design content.
Featureless grey pebble blob with no breaks, details or material separation.
Plain grey egg-shaped blob; no breaks, details or material separation.
